links.pilot: none; smoke runs under smoke/ are development checks of the instrument, not data

question: On the m=8 PKM Kummer-chain system over prime fields, how does the complete charged work c(B) of one positive sparse solver invocation scale with B=2^t, and is the measured exponent gamma below the gates 3.5 (all-output) and 3 (one-output)?

claims.text: Cell derivation, target classification (real and algebraic decompositions), solver-output verification and useful-relation rank are exact computations.
The per-call work exponent gamma between B=4 and B=8 (lower bound from B=16) lies above or below 3.5.
The projected whole-attack exponent E_all(gamma) of the Lean cost-floor model and its distance to 1/2.

arms.description: msolve 0.6.5 F4 (-t 8 -v 2 -g 2 -P 1) on the raw chain presentation; native extraction and verification
crypto_lib f4_fp grevlex single thread on byte-identical polynomial sets; t=2 cells decisive, t=3 censored
native negation-map rho on each cell's hidden instance, 3 seeds; reference row only

cells.p_rule: least prime >= 2^14 with 4 | p-1 and prime-order curve
L1 decisive cell p=16801793 with its curve, g, zeta
least prime >= 2^28 with 16 | p-1; censor probe, lower bound only

targets_per_cell.classifier: exhaustive signed multisets of 8 real base points; algebraic count over F_{p^2} recorded

positive.expected: planted decomposition among extracted real decompositions when the call completes
positive.failure_means: instrument fault; the cell's SAT rows are invalid

aa.comparison: t2r7 SAT target 1 run first and last of the t=2 block
aa.expected: work_proxy identical; rho_AA = max/min cpu_s recorded

second_instrument.comparison: native f4 vs msolve at t=2 on byte-identical inputs
second_instrument.expected: same consistency verdict and solving degree

replication.comparison: t3r8 on the L1 curve vs committed A3 log round structure

variable_ledger.factor: instrument (commit, binary sha256, msolve package+hash, flags, threads)
host (one RunPod pod; lscpu, RAM recorded)
variable_ledger.treatment: measured; shared by all rows; co-tenancy uncontrolled (L0)
fixed; A/A first and last of the t=2 block

seeds.derivation: StdRng seeded by master xor sha256(cell slug); hidden k and (a_j,b_j) from a separate seeded stream sealed in hidden.json

blinding.note: SAT/UNSAT labels are public for stratification only; the solver pipeline never reads hidden.json; the analyst reads runs.jsonl only after done.json

primary_metrics.name: work_proxy
primary_metrics.unit: sum over F4 rounds of rows x cols x density

decision_rule.gamma_lo: log2(min_j c_lo(8,j) / max_j c(4,j)) over natural targets; censored rows enter as lower bounds
decision_rule.gamma_hi: log2(max_j c(8,j) / min_j c(4,j)); +inf unless a t=3 natural row completed
decision_rule.KILL: gamma_lo >= 3.5 on both observables with all controls passing (scope: msolve 0.6.5 F4 and native f4 on the raw chain presentation at measured scale)
decision_rule.NOT_KILLED_at_B_le_8: gamma_hi < 3.5 on both observables and verified natural positives at t=3; reported as INCONCLUSIVE with direction; ADVANCE impossible (held-out t=4,5 unavailable)
decision_rule.censoring: a cap-stopped call is a lower bound on c(B); may support KILL, never NOT_KILLED

tables: per-call rows (cell, target, label, solver, cpu_s, wall_s, max_rss, censored, work_proxy, max_round_degree, useful_relations, rank_increment)
per-cell summary (median, min, max, censored count) per observable
gamma table (4->8, 8->16 lower bound) per observable
